solution.p: Since t is already isolated in the second equation line, we will use that and substitute {-5\mathopen{}\left(m+2\right)+18} in for t in the first equation: \begin{aligned} {5m+\left(-5\mathopen{}\left(m+2\right)\right)+18}\amp=-9\\ {5m-5m-10+18}\amp=-9\\ {8}\amp=-9 \end{aligned} This is an outright false equation, so there is no solution.
